meta.description: Maine's distributed-generation compensation record, compiled from the MPUC data response to Dichotomy Energy's request. Feeds the DER-compensation / ratepayer-recovery side of the negative-node model: NEB is the primary driver of behind-the-meter and community solar buildout in Maine, which in turn drives negative-price hours at the ISONE nodes tracked by this platform.

response.title: Director of Electric and Natural Gas Division, Maine Public Utilities Commission

source.note: Data pointers provided informally; MPUC noted further detail may require a formal FOAA request.

neb_tariff.governing_order_note: December 17, 2025 order in Docket 2019-00197 sets NEB tariff rates for calendar years 2026-2046. Prior-year rates are set by earlier orders in the same docket.

programs.name: Tariff-Rate NEB
programs.escalation: Set per the governing order; see schedule below (rate values not published in the email response — pull from the 2025-12-17 order).

programs.name: Commercial NEB (kWh-credit program)
programs.note: kWh-credit compensation is not fixed ahead of time; the credit value depends on the delivery and supply rates in effect at the time each credit is applied. Model this dynamically off CMP / Versant delivery + standard-offer supply rates rather than a static schedule.

net_benefits_reports.title: Analysis of Net Benefits of Net Energy Billing
net_benefits_reports.location: "Reports to the Legislature" section of the MPUC website
net_benefits_reports.use: Calibrates the ratepayer-recovery / cost-of-NEB component of the retail-rate model.

stranded_cost_dockets.note: Recent stranded-cost dockets by utility. NOT specific to NEB costs — per MPUC, these are general stranded-cost proceedings and should not be read as isolating NEB cost recovery.

generation_storage_projects.note: MPUC does not publish, and is not in possession of, a comprehensive machine-readable index of generation and storage projects (name, location, capacity, technology, status).

best_available_source.description: Monthly reports filed by the utilities. Closest available substitute for a generation/storage project index.

generation_storage_projects.cross_reference: For ISONE-interconnected capacity, this platform already tracks the ISONE Interconnection Queue (see isone_data_fetcher.fetch_and_parse_queue); the MPUC docket 2020-00199 filings cover distribution-level projects the ISONE queue omits.
